name: dogfood-profiling-app
description: Dogfood app v1.35-4 — a continuous profiling + pyroscope + eBPF profiler harness driven behind a provider-neutral surface backed by @kiwa-lab/observability v2.1 semantics (profiling axis + cardinality guard) + real-driver env-gate. Two adapter implementations satisfy the same 16-op contract: makeMockAdapter walks the observability v2.1 profiling state machine deterministically without any backend; makeRealAdapter emits pyroscope ingest + Parca gRPC + eBPF profiler pipeline requests through the KIWA_MODE=real testcontainers-driven Pyroscope + Parca stack when KIWA_PYROSCOPE_URL / KIWA_PARCA_URL are wired, and otherwise reports KIWA_PROFILING_ENV_MISSING so callers can budget the fallback. The fidelity harness diffs both traces side-by-side across 4 profile kinds (cpu / off-cpu / memory / lock) × 3 profiler backends (pyroscope / parca / ebpf) so behavioural drift between mock semantics and the real Pyroscope + Parca + eBPF stack stays observable and feeds the @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 13-axis release gate.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/observability @kiwa-lab/core @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
